title: BreakFast & Furious
author: Club Valentine
description: Join Jimmy Kavanagh, his part-time co-host Julie Duffy, and a plethora of special guests as they watch every Fast & Furious film and discuss them over breakfast. The only show on the air that gives you film discussion and breakfast recipes in every episode, all for the sake of a pun that doesn't quite work! #VroomVroom
